outcome: reduced translation of mutant PHOX2B protein
impaired ability to activate PHOX2A promoter
retention of PHOX2B on the nuclear membrane
impaired normal function of the nuclear membrane
cohort: The study involved a single patient diagnosed with severe congenital central hypoventilation syndrome (CCHS).
finding: The novel c.676_677insG (p.Ala226fs) PHOX2B mutation was found to reduce PHOX2B protein translation, impair PHOX2A promoter activation due to haploinsufficiency, and cause retention of PHOX2B on the nuclear membrane, potentially leading to cellular morbidity.
